description: Verify that the Type 1 entry Major Version of the notification is configured SERVICE-ID-1-MAJ-VER
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Type 1 entry Major Version must equal configured SERVICE-ID-1-MAJ-VER. The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's Type 1 entry Major Version == configured SERVICE-ID-1-MAJ-VER   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Type 1 entry Major Version on the wire equals configured SERVICE-ID-1-MAJ-VER.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_major_version — Entry major_version mismatch
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted Type 1 entry Major Version == configured SERVICE-ID-1-MAJ-VER — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
